{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Recompute mean revenue after removing QA orders
mean_revenue_clean = df_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"\nMean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue_clean}")

# Confirm the number of QA orders removed
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders removed: {(df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()}")"}
